title: The Wicked King
author: Holly Black
summary: Jude has placed Cardan on the throne of Faerie and now holds real power from behind it. She has to guard against plots from every side while he works to resist her control.
readIf: you enjoyed The Cruel Prince and like faerie court scheming with a spiky, back-and-forth romance.
skipIf: you haven't read the first book, as this one depends heavily on it.
